合併・買収・資金調達

relations.text: Qorvoは、Luxshareとの供給契約に基づき、Luxshareによる組立・テストの実施後に、同社に販売した在庫を買い戻す義務を負っている
relations.text_en: Under a supply agreement with Luxshare, Qorvo is obligated to repurchase inventory it sold to Luxshare after Luxshare performs assembly and test services

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: Pursuant to a supply agreement with Luxshare, the Company is obligated to repurchase inventory that it sold to Luxshare subsequent to the performance of assembly and test services by Luxshare.

relations.text: Luxshareに販売し将来買い戻す義務のある在庫について、現金を受け取っている
relations.text_en: Qorvo received cash for inventory sold to Luxshare that it is obligated to repurchase at a future date

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: The cash received for inventory related to inventory that the Company sold to Luxshare and is obligated to repurchase at a future date subsequent to the performance of assembly and test services by Luxshare pursuant to a supply agreement.

relations.text: Qorvoは最大のエンドカスタマーAppleに、複数の受託製造業者を通じて製品を提供しており、売上高の2026年度約50%、2025年度約47%を占める
relations.text_en: Qorvo provides products to its largest end customer, Apple, through multiple contract manufacturers, which accounted for approximately 50% and 47% of total revenue in fiscal years 2026 and 2025

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: We provide products to our largest end customer (Apple) through sales to multiple contract manufacturers, which in the aggregate accounted for approximately 50% and 47% of total revenue in fiscal years 2026 and 2025, respectively.

companies.name: サムスン電子
companies.sub: スマートフォン・家電

relations.text: Samsungは、売上高の2026年度・2025年度とも約10%を占めた
relations.text_en: Samsung accounted for approximately 10% of total revenue in both fiscal years 2026 and 2025

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: Samsung accounted for approximately 10% of total revenue in both fiscal years 2026 and 2025.

relations.text: Qorvoの年次報告が、Skyworksとの合併の成否は、両社の事業を円滑に統合できるかに左右されると記載している
relations.text_en: Qorvo's annual report says the success of the Mergers with Skyworks depends in part on integrating the two companies' operations

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: The success of the Mergers, including anticipated benefits and cost synergies, will depend, in part, on our and Skyworks’ ability to successfully integrate our respective operations in a manner that results in various benefits and that does not materially disrupt existing business and strategic relationships or result in a loss of customers.
source.note: 合併は計画段階の記載です。

relations.text: Skyworksの年次報告が、Qorvoとの合併の行方が不確実なことが取引先との関係に影響し得ると記載している
relations.text_en: Skyworks' annual report says uncertainty about the outcome of the Mergers with Qorvo could disrupt its business relationships

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: Uncertainty regarding the outcome of the Mergers and our future could disrupt our business relationships with our existing and potential customers, distributors, service providers and other business partners, who may attempt to negotiate changes in existing business relationships or consider entering into business relationships with parties other than Qorvo.

relations.text: スカイワークスの年次報告が、コルボを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names Qorvo as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Skyworks Solutions 10-K
source.quote: We compete with international and United States semiconductor manufacturers of all sizes in terms of resources and market share, including, but not limited to, Analog Devices, Broadcom, Cirrus Logic, Murata Manufacturing, NXP Semiconductors, Qorvo, Qualcomm, and Texas Instruments.

relations.text: onsemiは2025年1月14日に、Qorvo US, Inc.などからSiC JFET技術事業の全持分を118.8百万ドルの現金で取得した
relations.text_en: On January 14, 2025 onsemi acquired all of the equity of the SiC JFET technology business from Qorvo US, Inc. and certain subsidiaries for $118.8 million in cash

source.label: onsemi 10-K
source.quote: On January 14, 2025, the Company acquired all of the outstanding equity of the SiC JFET technology business from Qorvo US, Inc., and certain of its subsidiaries, for $ 118.8 million in cash, subject to working capital adjustments.

companies.name: バンク・オブ・アメリカ

relations.text: Qorvoは2024年4月23日に、Bank of America, N.A.を管理代理人とする5年物の無担保シニア・クレジット・ファシリティ契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On April 23, 2024 Qorvo entered into a five-year unsecured senior credit facility under a credit agreement with Bank of America, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Qorvo 10-K
source.quote: On April 23, 2024, we entered into a five-year unsecured senior credit facility pursuant to a credit agreement with Bank of America, N.A., as administrative agent, swing line lender and letter of credit issuer and a syndicate of lenders (the “Credit Agreement”), which replaced our previous credit agreement.
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。
